whatsappMessage:
Hi Team MMA Arena,

I noticed your MMA academy has stellar 4.9★ reviews in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new trial inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, fighter training programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mmaarena

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi MMA Arena team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (MMA Arena Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and fighter training highlights for your location in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai. Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact classes aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough!
